answer: Each agent identity must post a slashable stake bond and a hardware attestation tying its key to one physical device, so one operator cannot mint many identities from one machine. Every epoch a random beacon seeds reward slots, and keys sharing a device fingerprint, funding source, or timing are clustered and burned. N sybils thus cost N separate bonds of real copper and N real machines, and coalescing them destroys the kernel of capital, while an honest joiner risks one bond. The attacker's bill grows linearly per fake seat, so payoff drops below break-even before any vote shifts.
